newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks seen mixed amid some profit taking.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks seen mixed amid some profit taking.

text.p: Share prices on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) are expected to be mixed when the market reopens on Sunday after the two-day weekend, brokers said.
"Investors are likely to book profit on select scrips. They may eye low-priced shares," said Golam Sarwar of Mahbub Morshed and Company.

Singer Bangladesh and Bangladesh Lamps might fall marginally on profit taking while Beximco Pharmaceutical, Apex Tannery, Bata and Bangladesh Oxygen may rise, brokers said. The DSE all-share price index rose 1.13 points or 0.09 percent at 1,216.68 on Thursday. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
